avis.titre: Lightweight Serum That Leaves Skin Looking Fresh
avis.texte: I've been using Total RF Serum consistently and really enjoy how lightweight it feels on my skin. It absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue and layers well under moisturizer and makeup. After regular use, my skin looks more hydrated and feels smoother to the touch. I also noticed a subtle improvement in how plump and refreshed my skin appears. It feels gentle and comfortable, and I appreciate that it doesn't irritate my skin. Overall, it's a great addition to my skincare routine.
